reviews.title: Best AIO for SP5. Great Quality at Lower Price Than Silverstone.
reviews.comment:
Arctic is an anomoly of the tech world. They give you quality in engineering with good materials without the markup snobbery. This functions flawlessly. I think one thing of note, as with all SP5's if you are stuck in building a desktop Epyc Genoa at home you need this. I was doing air cooling, and the sheer size and cantilever effect creates uneven pressure when moved and consequently no post. I switched to AIO and my Epyc will post regardless of how many times I move it out from under my desk to remove hardware. I went through 3 air coolers, thinking it was a defect, but no-- this keeps temps even lower and it maintains an even pressure. My set up got creative as I needed to maximize the space inside my desktop computer.
I love Arctic stuff as they are good people. They are fair and helpful with any issues you may have. I did a vinyl wrap in white as they don't make them in white yet. I also have it running on top of my case as the plumbing allows a little freedom to do so.
reviews.author: marla maiden
